findings.action: R3 requires identity changes during cleanup to leave cleanup incomplete. Identity is checked only when the build directory is opened at lines 622-625. If that directory is subsequently renamed outside the runtime root and an empty replacement is installed at its original name, removal continues through the original descriptor, root.Remove deletes the replacement, and the outer cleanup can report success while the renamed directory remains. Disappearance is also silently accepted here. Preserve and verify the parent-name binding before confirming cleanup, and add a synchronized regression for replacement after the initial identity check. The spec's cited TestAdapterContainmentCleanupCapturedRootsRefuseReplacement replaces runtime or registration roots before cleanup; it does not exercise this build-directory window.
